title: Puthoff floats a joint space program

tellings.quote: I was like is it is it their program you know is it the NHI program or is it our program and he goes what if it's a joint space program

plain: Hal Puthoff, a physicist long tied to government studies of psychic and UFO topics, is said to have suggested that a secret space program might be run jointly by humans and non-human beings. An online UFO researcher who goes by UAPGerb tells Michels in 2025 that he asked Puthoff whether the program was "the NHI program or is it our program", and Puthoff answered, "what if it's a joint space program." If true, it would mean humans and non-humans are already working together.
